page.layout: One printed page, dedication. A large centred title block in capitals and italic at the top, then one paragraph of running text with a woodcut initial E, set in full width, ending with the signature mark at the foot. No marginal notes, running head or page number.

main_text.head: AMPLISSIMO PRV-DENTISSIMOQVE VIRO, D. JOHANNI CVNRADO MEYERO, in-clytæ Reipub. Schaphusianæ Consuli grauissi-mo, utriusq; Juris Doctori præstantissimo, Domino ac Patrono sibi plurimum reuerendo, pacem & gratiam à Deo.
main_text.p: ETSI MVLTÆ SVNT CAVSSÆ, candide Lector, cur viri cordati Jacobi Andreæ conuiciis & calumnijs non ampliusrespondendum esse arbitrantur: tamen plures & grauiores eosdem moue-runt, quibus adducti censuerunt,postremo eius scripto, cui Cuculi nomen imposuit, omninò respondendum esse. Nam etsi homines,qui omnibus pietatis, humanitatis & modestiæ repagulis perruptis,in obuios quosuis, & leuissima de caussa saeuiunt, contemtu potius, quam responso digni sunt: tamen ne omnibus impunè insultare,quiduis confingere,temerè calumniari se posse animum inducant suum, prodest interdum eorum furoribus pessulum obdere, impudentem calumniandi, mentiendique libidinem liberè detegere, & inprimis veram Euangelij doctrinam, quam illi obscurare & cui vim inferre conantur, ab eorum corruptelis constanter vindicare. Quapropter operæ pretium erat Jacobi Andreæ Cuculi, partus certè infelicis & infausti libidinem & temeritatem, hoc scripto, quoad eius fieri posset, reprimere & compescere: cùm omninò in grege eorum, de quibus modò diximus,

page.notes: The woodcut initial E is joined to the first word, so the paragraph opens "ETSI". The top margin shows faint show-through from the reverse side, which is left out. Spacing as printed: "ampliusrespondendum", "perruptis,in", "postremo"/"re-spondendum" and "Quapropter" are set without the usual space or hyphen. "Iacobi" and "Iohanni" are read with J as consonant. Some letters are soft and were read with care, but none is marked as uncertain.
